exposure: ongoing pregnancy at or beyond 40 0/7 weeks of gestation
cohort: 11,308 nulliparous women with a singleton fetus in the cephalic presentation who gave birth at term (≥37 0/7 weeks of gestation) in a French perinatal network
finding: Cesarean delivery rates increased starting at 40 0/7 weeks of gestation in ongoing pregnancies regardless of the mode of labor onset.
mod_finding: The study found that cesarean delivery rates increased starting at 40 0/7 weeks of gestation in ongoing pregnancies regardless of the mode of labor onset.
